errors.text_span: der kürzeste den Wert -16,3 für das Vereinigte Königreich darstellt
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the bar for the United Kingdom (-16.3) as the shortest. The length of the bars corresponds to their absolute value. The shortest bar is for the USA, which has a value of -9.4 (absolute length 9.4).

errors.text_span: Die Balken sind nicht in einer bestimmten numerischen Reihenfolge sortiert
errors.evidence: This statement is false. The bars are sorted numerically within each of the two groups. The bars for countries with negative performance are sorted from most negative (-16.3) to least negative (-9.4). The bars for countries with positive performance are sorted from least positive (23.3) to most positive (67.7).
